title: Praising one’s own cooking
odia:
ଆପେ ରାନ୍ଧି ଆପେ ଖାଏ
ସୁଆଦ ସୁଆଦ ବୋଲୁଥାଏ ।
literal_meaning: They cook it themselves, eat it themselves, and keep saying, “Tasty, tasty.”
meaning_odia: ନିଜେ ତିଆରି କରିଥିବା ଜିନିଷକୁ ନିଜେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର। ଏହାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ନିଜ କାମର ନିଜେ ପ୍ରଶଂସକ ହେବା ଉପରେ ଥଟ୍ଟା ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Cook, eater and enthusiastic reviewer are all the same person. The repeated praise makes the scene comic. This edition reads it as a teasing picture of self-praise, where the maker supplies the applause as well as the work.
usage_example: Someone presents their own design and repeatedly announces how excellent it is before anyone else responds. A listener might recall this cooking scene. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The repeated ଆପେ stresses doing both parts oneself; repeated ସୁଆଦ supplies the approving refrain. Enjoying one’s own food is the literal scene, while self-congratulation is the editorial figurative reading. No particular dish or cooking tradition is specified.

odia_summary: ନିଜ କାମକୁ ନିଜେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ବାହାବା ଦେବାର ଥଟ୍ଟା।
english_summary: The maker is also the loudest admirer of the work.
